evals.prompt: Plan a new Amp user-plugin mode with GPT-6 Sol at medium effort for main, GPT-6 Sol at high for Oracle, and GPT-6 Luna at max for subagents. Use the existing personal plugins checkout. Explain the exact source and verification steps, but make no changes.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the personal plugins repository, covers mode registration and discoverability metadata, checks model and tool policy, and validates the loaded mode before deployment.
expectations: Identifies the personal plugins checkout as the mode source.
Checks both the mode registry and @amp-agent-mode header.
Checks model IDs, tool policy, typecheck, and loaded mode settings.

evals.prompt: An Amp custom-url router already has several model mappings. Plan how to add one more mapping for a mode whose Oracle uses a second model. Explain verification, but do not change the router.
evals.expected_output: Reads both model inventories and the full existing router mapping, preserves unrelated entries, verifies main and Oracle routes after the edit.
expectations: Distinguishes Amp model IDs from backend model IDs.
States that edit-router --model-mapping replaces the whole list and preserves existing entries and their matching order.
Verifies both the main and Oracle routes after an authorized edit.

evals.prompt: Plan a reload of one long-lived Amp runner on a host where someone also has an interactive Amp session. The user has authorized reloading only the runner. Explain the action and proof of recovery, but execute nothing.
evals.expected_output: Avoids host-wide pkill, targets the runner or supervisor, and verifies a new runner PID and service state.
expectations: Does not recommend pkill -x amp for a runner-only authorization.
Distinguishes the long-lived runner from the interactive session.
Checks the replacement Amp PID and supervisor state.

evals.prompt: An Amp keybinding keeps reverting after I edit ~/.config/amp/settings.json and run the agent sync. Diagnose where the durable change belongs and how to verify it. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Finds the sync-owned settings source and verifies the installed copy after sync without treating the generated home as authoritative.
expectations: Names harnesses/amp/settings.json in the agent configuration repository as the durable settings source.
Does not recommend editing the generated ~/.config/amp/settings.json as the fix.
Checks the relevant harness instructions and compares the installed setting after sync.

evals.prompt: I explicitly authorize pkill -x amp on hosts alpha and beta so their supervised Amp runners auto-restart. Describe the execution and recovery checks for those two hosts, but do not run commands in this evaluation.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing approval, limits the operation to alpha and beta, and verifies a new Amp runner process on each host.
expectations: Treats the explicit host-wide restart authorization as sufficient without asking again.
Limits pkill -x amp to alpha and beta and acknowledges that it also stops interactive Amp sessions there.
Records old runner PIDs and checks each supervisor plus a new Amp runner PID after restart.

evals.prompt: The exact model mapping exists on our Amp custom router, but a previous check-access call reported that a subscription connection served the model. Diagnose the route and propose the smallest fix. Do not run commands or change configuration.
evals.expected_output: Finds the higher-priority matching connection and proposes a targeted priority or exclusion change instead of duplicating the mapping.
expectations: Checks active connection order and matching mappings, including personal versus workspace precedence.
Explains that the first active matching connection wins and does not add a duplicate mapping as the fix.
Proposes a targeted priority or exclusion change and verifies the serving connection after authorization.
